notes.title: A little update (and a discount!) to celebrate the Switch launch
notes.content: [p]To celebrate our Nintendo Switch release (!!!) we wanted to give a [b]special discount here on Steam[/b] as a [b]huge thank you[/b] for all the love and support you’ve shown us. 💛[/p][p align="start"]We’re also rolling out a small but handy [b]camera shortcut update[/b] to make decorating and organizing your Camper Van even smoother and cozier. 🪴✨[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/dd62e7c4a4b1be675b72bfd801dde6b897366cfc.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]We know this update isn’t [i]quite[/i] as hype as Silksong news… but we’re here to be your cozy little break when you need one. 🌿☕ [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/7866bf9ffc9b6a1a33056d7b38a9ef94b198d1d2.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Thanks for being the best part of this journey![/p]

notes.title: The Creative Mode update is here
notes.content:
[p]The [b]Creative Mode update[/b] is here ✨🚐
This new mode lets you decorate and customize your camper van without limits. All items unlocked, new colors to try out, and even the chance to set the atmosphere just the way you like it. It’s the perfect space to slow down, experiment, and make the van truly yours 🌿💛[/p][p align="start"][b]Creative Mode includes:[/b]
🪑 Access every item in your inventory and decorate your camper van any way you like
🎨 New color options for more freedom in customization
🌦 Atmospheric effects and the ability to switch between day, evening, and night 🌞🌙
🐶 Change your pet whenever you want
🗺 Choose and change your travel destination at any time
🎵 Pick your favorite track with the music selector

We’ve also fixed many of the bugs you kindly reported here on the forums and on social media 🛠️💌[/p][p]And we’ve enabled [b]Steam Cloud[/b], so your saves will always be safe and available no matter where you play ☁️💾
[/p][p align="start"]We can’t wait to see your creations and share this new chapter of the journey with you 🌈✨[/p][p align="start"]And that’s not all… we’re thrilled to announce that [b]Camper Van: Make It Home is coming to Nintendo Switch on September 4th[/b]! 🎮💖[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/3231033e71d4683c9ecad23966e566006776576f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/9fb3b73fe04f662ea3e41adf4f53626648707c47.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.2 is Live!
notes.content:
[p]🚨 [b]New Update is Live![/b] 🚨 [i]Update 1.2[/i][/p][p]We’re continuing to improve [b]Camper Van[/b], and your suggestions have been a huge help. Thank you so much for all the love and feedback, it’s really helping us shape the game. 💛[/p][p][/p][p][b]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/b][/p][p]🌀 [b]Level Reset Button[/b]
You can now restart any level from the beginning, whenever you like. No need to finish it first. Perfect if you want a fresh start or need to fix a mistake.[/p][p]🥕 [b]More control over food items[/b]
You can now right-click to remove veggies, spices, legumes, and liquids from baskets. Many of you asked for more freedom when organizing food, and now you’ve got it.[/p][p]🐞 [b]Bug fixes[/b]
We’ve fixed a number of bugs to make the game smoother and more enjoyable overall.[/p][p]🎧 [b]Improved UI sounds[/b]
We updated the pick-up sounds from the interface to match the in-game grab sound, making the whole experience feel more natural and satisfying.[/p][p]🎁 [b]New collectible in the Cliff Mission[/b]
This mission had fewer collectibles, which made things a bit confusing. We’ve added a new one to make exploration clearer and more rewarding.[/p][p]📖 [b]Narrative improvements[/b]
We’ve added more details to help you get to know the traveler better, including her personality, hobbies, and tastes.[/p][p]🕹️ [b]Interactive game console[/b]
You can now interact with the traveler’s handheld console. Wonder what she’s playing today?[/p][p]☕ [b]All mugs can now be refilled[/b]
Yes, even the special ones. Now every cup can be filled to complete your perfect setup.[/p][p]⚙️ [b]New FPS limit option[/b]
We’ve added a setting to limit frame rate, which helps improve performance on lower-end PCs.[/p][p]And finally, some exciting news
We’ve started working on [b]Creative Mode[/b], a new way to play Camper Van where you’ll be free to choose which van to decorate, where to travel, and which items to include or leave out. You’ll have access to all objects, even the ones we didn’t include in the main game because they didn’t fit the story.[/p][p]This will be a [b]free update[/b] designed to give you more freedom and make the experience even more fun and personal. We can’t wait to show you more soon.[/p]

notes.title: Camper Van 1.1. Thank you update
notes.content:
[p]First of all, [b]thank you so much for all your feedback[/b]. Your messages, comments, and suggestions have helped us make the game better in so many ways 💛[/p][p]Here’s what’s new:[/p][p]🎬 [b]Story & Narrative[/b]
We’ve added a short [i]tutorial for the projector[/i] and new [i]slides[/i] to help make the story clearer.
Oh, and there’s a little [i]post-credits scene[/i] now too 👀[/p][p]📦 [b]Objects & Gamefeel[/b] We heard you. Having too many items was frustrating for a lot of players. We've rebalanced things and moved around some objects to make organizing more fun and less overwhelming. 🚨 [b]Heads up![/b] 🚨 
As we've rebalanced the game and moved around some items, you might notice a few duplicated objects in games that were already started or completed. Thanks for your understanding![/p][p]🐶 [b]Collars for pets![/b]
So many of you tried to put the collar on your pets... and now you finally can! 🥹[/p][p]🧊 [b]Stacking & Freezer fixes[/b]
Lots of objects can now be stacked, and we’ve improved the freezer so placing frozen food and ice cream makes more sense![/p][p]🧱 [b]Better collision feedback[/b]
Now when objects bump into each other while organizing, there’s a little visual feedback to make it clearer what's happening.[/p][p]☕ [b]Cup placement improved[/b]
Cups can now be placed much closer together, so go ahead and create that cozy mug collection![/p][p]🐛 [b]Bug fixes[/b]
We’ve fixed a bunch of bugs that could block progress while playing. Thanks so much for reporting them![/p][p]📸 [b]Photo Mode improvements[/b]
Photo Mode now works as it should (no more bugs!) and we’ve added visual feedback when taking pictures, plus a clear message telling you [i]exactly where they’re saved[/i] on your computer.[/p][p]🕯️ [b]M6 candles[/b]
Candles in Mission 6 now light up on their own and no longer cause any bugs 😅[/p][p]📏 [b]Smaller object sizes[/b]
Some items were just too big to place easily, so we’ve made a few of them smaller to help with organizing.[/p][p]🌍 [b]Post-game feature[/b]
After finishing the game, you’ll now be able to [i]go back and revisit each mission's destination[/i] whenever you want 💫[/p][p]Thanks again for being such an amazing community. We’re reading everything, so keep the feedback coming! 💌

Best,
Camper Van Team
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/5aaf449ff5ae9640836a30a6d27a4b432ecdba4e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Enjoying the game? Your review can help us build something new!
notes.content: [p][b]Hi everyone! 🌼[/b][/p][p]Just a quick update to say a big [b]thank you[/b] to the Steam community for all the lovely messages, feedback, and support since launch. ✨[/p][p]We’re reading everything: your comments, suggestions, and even bug reports, and it’s incredibly helpful. Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts with us![/p][p]Now that the game is out in the world, we wanted to ask for a small favor. If you’re enjoying it, leaving a [b]positive review on Steam[/b] would mean the world to us. For small indie teams like ours, the first weeks after launch are critical. Reviews help give the game visibility, keep the momentum going, and open the door for future updates. ❤️‍🩹[/p][p]One thing we’d love to work on is the [b]CREATIVE[/b], an idea that didn’t quite make it into the Kickstarter stretch goals,  a mode where you’ll be able to choose what to place, where to travel, and decorate your van freely. If the game does well and reviews help boost its visibility, there’s a real chance we can start developing it soon. [b]Not as paid DLC[/b], [b]but as a[/b] [b]FREE UPDATE[/b] for everyone. That would be a dream for us. 🚚🪴[/p][p]Thank you again for being part of this journey. We’re learning every day, and your support truly makes all the difference. 💛[/p][p][b]Camper Van Team 🚚🪴[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/222ff07c736430a22f979e5ddc0c3b0aacc14944.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Camper Van: Make It Home is now live on Steam!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone! 💖[/p][p]I can hardly believe I’m writing this… but it’s true — [i]Camper Van: Make It Home[/i] is officially out now on [b]Steam![/b] 🥹
You can play it on [b]Windows[/b], [b]macOS[/b], and it’s also [b]Steam Deck Verified![/b] 🎮✨[/p][p]We decided to launch as a surprise alongside the lovely [b]Wholesome Direct[/b], and we’re incredibly grateful to the event team for all their kindness and support 🌼[/p][p]To everyone who’s been with us from the very beginning:
Thank you. Thank you for every message, every kind word, and every bit of encouragement you’ve shared. This moment exists because of you. 🧡[/p][p]Though it may feel like the finish line, it’s really just the start of a long, cozy adventure we’ll share together in [i]Camper Van: Make It Home[/i].[/p][p]See you on the road! 🚐🌄[/p][p]With all our love,
Camper Van Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/c90be35e6116417174a469eade8dbf4835d026ec.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Camper Van: Make It Home is Part of Steam Next Fest! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone, it’s Anabel from Malapata Studio! 😊 We have some big news—Camper Van: Make It Home will be part of Steam Next Fest, running from February 24 to March 3!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/1dac25db20d1b1b96bffe36d9b3fd660c20c9d79.png[/img]
To celebrate, we’ve expanded the demo so you can finally customize your van in the workshop! 🛠️✨ Now you’ll get a taste of what it’s like to truly make your camper feel like home. Plus, we’ve made tons of improvements: a revamped UI, new decorating items, more color options for your van, and overall enhanced gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/bff4a5c69539f168327d1764262534bd0142b836.jpg[/img]
And we have another exciting announcement—Camper Van: Make It Home is officially launching in 2025! 🎉 We’re really sorry for the delay. It took us over a year to secure full funding for the game, which set us back a few months. But now, we’re more energized than ever and can’t wait to show you everything we’ve been working on!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/186629aa080a6026aa850091e752de41745d157b.jpg[/img]
A huge thank you to the 88,000+ of you who have supported us by wishlisting the game. Seeing our Kickstarter get fully funded in just 16 hours was an unforgettable moment, and watching the wishlist numbers grow every day fills us with so much gratitude. We’re beyond excited to bring this game to life for you all.
Be sure to try out the new demo, let us know what you think, and follow us on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/malapatastudio.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://x.com/malapatastudio]Twitter[/url] (ugh, not the best place these days, so we recommend Bluesky instead 😆), [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@malapatastudio]TikTok[/url], and[url=https://www.instagram.com/malapatastudio] Instagram[/url] for more updates.
Take care, and see you soon!! 🚐✨

notes.title: Juanma Latorre of Vetusta Morla Composes the Soundtrack for Camper Van
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce a new update to the Camper Van: Make it Home demo, just in time for the Save & Sound event! This update not only addresses several bug fixes but also introduces a significant upgrade to the soundtrack, featuring compositions by Juanma Latorre of the renowned band Vetusta Morla. Latorre’s music brings a fresh, immersive layer to the game, capturing the spirit of exploration and the freedom of life on the road.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/af1520f856b75e89624a18f61cb085607e137112.png[/img]

Bugs Fixed, Experience Improved
Our team has been hard at work addressing player feedback to create a smoother and more enjoyable experience. This demo update includes a variety of bug fixes that improve gameplay and enhance the overall flow of the Camper Van experience. 

New Soundtrack by Juanma Latorre
Perhaps the most exciting part of this update is the debut of Juanma Latorre’s music as Camper Van: Make it Home’s official soundtrack. Latorre, a talented guitarist and composer from Vetusta Morla, joined the project through a mutual connection and was captivated by the game’s themes of self-discovery and connection with nature. For him, the soundtrack needed to embody the sense of freedom, the beauty of exploring the unknown, and the quiet moments of introspection that life on the road offers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/3c8b82be4ededc885e702545e32b23e5cf051e80.jpg[/img]

Where to Experience the New Update
To hear Juanma Latorre’s contributions for yourself, visit our demo on Steam, where the new soundtrack is now live! The Save & Sound event, happening from November 4 to 7, will also showcase this update through a brand-new video, where you can get a glimpse of the music that defines the Camper Van experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/ca19ee2d9d8735ee698835f2480255100059d8da.png[/img]

Curious about the music that will accompany your journey?

notes.title: The Camper Van: Make It Home Demo is Now Available for Mac!
notes.content:
The Camper Van: Make It Home Demo is Now Available for Mac!

We couldn’t take part in the Indie Arena Booth at Gamescom without bringing something special. That’s why we’ve worked hard to release the Mac demo today. Mac users can now jump in, set up their camper van, and explore the scenic landscapes on the road. This demo gives you a sneak peek at the core mechanics of the game, but it’s just the beginning.

We’re continuously working on improvements and adding more content in future updates. Don’t miss the chance to try it out and share your feedback with us!

Thank you for joining us on this exciting journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/29e2a8585c731b11c081826f9fdac683794026c7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Demo Update & Exciting News!
notes.content:
🎉 Demo Update & Exciting News! 🎮

Over the past few months, we’ve carefully read all your feedback and have been hard at work improving the experience. Here are some fresh updates now available in the demo:

✨ New Features:

💾 Save System: You can now save and continue your game whenever you want!
📚 New Tutorial: Get started with a step-by-step guide to learn the game basics.
🎥 Improved Camera Controls: Smoother, more comfortable controls for better game feel.
🔄 New Interactive Objects: Explore and discover new interactions in the game!
🪴 New Plants: Give them a gentle touch and feel their fluffy movement!

It gets even better! The Mac version will be ready in a few days, just in time for Gamescom (21-25th Aug.)! 🎉 We’d love to hear what you think about these changes. Don’t forget to share your feedback so we can keep improving. 👾 Also coming soon, 🎮 Controller Support: Play how you prefer with full controller compatibility.

And to top it all off, here’s a sneak peek of what we’ve been working on lately:

✨ Narrative & Details: We’re polishing the story and adding even more unique details to in-game objects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/cf43c36fffa9eed70cc230cfdbfeb13977e05f2c.png[/img]

🐾 Pets Are Coming! We’ve started with the 3D models and the design of all the related items. We can’t wait for you to meet them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/83bdef496d239bc89d94a3e9ee30ceb2ace1f2d8.jpg[/img]

🏝️ Environments Are Getting a Glow Up: We’re refining each location to make them look their best.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/6181024d2d045b85295147e6ba13b57d9f83beca.jpg[/img]

And if you’re heading to Gamescom, be sure to drop by and say hi! We’ve got some awesome merch ready, and we’d love to get all the love and support you can share—we really need it at this stage!

notes.title: Camper Van: Make it Home Live
notes.content:
Camper Van: Make it Home is a videogame about camperizing your own van, where you will embark on a journey of personal discovery while you decorate and create a space for all your belongings.

This satisfying game invites you to create your own home space in a van combining elements of block organization puzzle games and interior design. Decorate and organize all your objects while you discover step by step what led our protagonist to embark on this journey.
